description: This file defines an interface for application logging, providing a way to abstract logging operations such as LogInformation and LogWarning without depending on specific logging frameworks.

classes.name: IAppLogger<T>
classes.description: A generic interface that abstracts logging functionalities such as logging information and warnings, designed to decouple the application code from specific logging implementations.

methods.name: LogInformation
methods.description: Logs informational messages, accepting a message template and optional arguments.

methods.name: LogWarning
methods.description: Logs warning messages, accepting a message template and optional arguments.
